response.sql:
SELECT f.language_id, AVG(f.replacement_cost) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(f.length) AS avg_running_time
FROM film AS f
WHERE f.length >= 112
GROUP BY f.language_id
ORDER BY avg_running_time DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Treat “112 minutes as the cutoff for a long film” as including films whose length is exactly 112 minutes. AVG ignores NULL values, and NULL average running times sort last in descending order in MySQL.

alternatives.interpretation: If “longer than 112 minutes” means strictly greater than 112, exclude films exactly 112 minutes.
